introHtml: Custom green memo office clips offer a vibrant way to keep documents organized while promoting your brand. The green color stands out on desks and filing cabinets, making it easy for employees and clients to spot your logo. Choose from magnetic clips for metal surfaces or spring-loaded clips for papers and bags. These clips are a practical giveaway for trade shows, office supply orders, or corporate welcome kits.
